reason: Yu Chun keeps showing up on the blogs and Instagram accounts I follow, and chik naengmyeon in ice-cold broth is exactly what I want on a hot day, so I'd go once to see if it lives up to the name. At $18.95 for noodles it's normal Honolulu pricing, not a splurge on my income.
objection: People say the Japanese branches are just as good, so I'm not sure this one is special enough to come back to instead of the Korean spots I already know around Keeaumoku.
